datasets.title: SARS-CoV-2 full-length spike glycoprotein, closed state: all-atom MD
datasets.description: All-atom MD simulations of the full-length SARS-CoV-2 spike glycoprotein in the closed state (all RBDs 'down'), protein + glycans only (not aligned). PSF and DCD files are provided. 3 replicas.
datasets.data_availability: Trajectories stored on lab storage; available on request

datasets.title: SARS-CoV-2 full-length spike glycoprotein, open state, N165A/N234A: all-atom MD
datasets.description: All-atom MD simulations of the full-length SARS-CoV-2 spike glycoprotein in the open state (chain A RBD 'up') bearing the N165A and N234A substitutions, protein + glycans only (not aligned). PSF and DCD files are provided. 6 replicas; replicas 4-6 were run with adaptive sampling.
datasets.data_availability: Trajectories stored on lab storage; available on request
